title: Privacy Policy
meta: Version 1.0 · Document date: 11 August 2026 · Effective when this version is published on go-irl.fun
note: The Czech version is controlling. The English, Russian and Ukrainian translations are provided for user convenience.
body:
1. Controller and contact

The controller of personal data for the processing described in this Policy is Пашин Виталий Викторович, Masarykova třída 10, Olomouc, Czech Republic. Privacy and rights contact: Vitvolny26@gmail.com.

This Policy describes the processing of personal data in the current free beta version of GO IRL at go-irl.fun. It does not constitute legal approval of future payments, advertising, marketing profiling, new AI features, document-based age verification or intentional launch into jurisdictions not yet reviewed.

2. Scope

This Policy applies to personal data processed when using the website, supported sign-in flows, profiles, activities, join/request functions, event chat, moderation, security and requests concerning an account or personal data.

3. Data we may process

  • an external account identifier and limited data provided through a verified sign-in flow of a supported identity provider;
  • an internal account identifier, name, username, avatar, city, bio and other profile information provided by the user;
  • a record of the 18+ confirmation and acceptance of the current version of the Terms;
  • activity content, join/request status, participation relationships and related state data;
  • messages in event chat where chat is available;
  • approximate or precise location where required by a specific feature or provided by the user;
  • reports, moderation records and security evidence;
  • technical data needed for sign-in, security, diagnostics and operation, such as session/security identifiers, timestamps and relevant server logs;
  • information about requests for access, correction, restriction, objection, export or erasure.

For beta eligibility, GO IRL does not normally require date of birth, a copy of an identity document or the identity of a legal guardian.

4. Sources of data

We obtain data directly from the user, from their use of GO IRL, from an authorized sign-in flow of an external provider and, in limited cases, from another user, for example when content or a security incident is reported.

5. Purposes and legal bases

Account, authentication, profile, provider mapping, activity creation, join/request and provision of requested functions are processed to the extent necessary to provide the service and perform the contractual relationship under GDPR Article 6(1)(b).

Security logs, abuse prevention and proportionate protection of the service and users may be processed on the basis of legitimate interests under GDPR Article 6(1)(f).

Moderation, handling of reports and retention of relevant security evidence are processed for the relevant purpose on the basis of legitimate interests or a legal obligation where such an obligation actually applies.

Location data are processed only for the specific activated location feature. Device permission for location is not consent to unrelated tracking.

We rely on consent only where it is actually required for a specific optional purpose. Accepting the Terms or confirming that you had the opportunity to read this Policy is not blanket consent to personal-data processing.

6. Required and optional data

Data marked as necessary for an account or a specific feature must be provided if the user wants to use that account or feature. Optional data are not a condition for unrelated functions without a legitimate reason.

7. Sign-in through external providers

When signing in through a supported external provider, such as Google, Facebook or Telegram, GO IRL receives only data that are actually part of the permitted and verified sign-in flow. The external provider also processes data for its own purposes under its own terms and policies.

The exact list of active provider scopes and returned fields must match the actual production configuration; this Policy does not claim such details without runtime verification.

8. Recipients and providers

Depending on the actually active production configuration, personal data may be processed by providers necessary to operate GO IRL, in particular backend/database and authentication infrastructure, hosting infrastructure, and active identity providers or integration platforms.

Currently identified technical services include Supabase; canonical VPS/hosting infrastructure; Vercel for limited preview/share/meta transport functions where used in a particular flow; and supported external identity platforms where the relevant integration is active.

n8n, Google Drive, ClickUp or AI providers are not automatically approved by this text as general production channels for users’ personal data.

9. Transfers outside the EEA

Some external providers may process data outside the European Economic Area. Where Chapter V GDPR applies to such a transfer, GO IRL will use the appropriate mechanism for the specific provider and flow, such as an adequacy decision or appropriate safeguards including Standard Contractual Clauses where required.

10. Retention

GO IRL retains personal data only for as long as necessary for the processing purpose or as required or permitted by law. The specific period depends on the type of account, service activity, status of user content, security needs, open requests or disputes, and legal obligations.

Numerical retention periods will not be claimed until they have been verified against the actual production configuration.

11. Erasure and legal exceptions

A user may request deletion of the account and personal data at Vitvolny26@gmail.com. Some data may be retained for a limited period where necessary for a legal obligation, security, abuse prevention, dispute resolution or evidentiary purposes.

12. User rights

Under applicable law, the user may have rights of access, correction, erasure, restriction of processing, portability, objection and withdrawal of consent where processing is actually based on consent. Requests may be sent to Vitvolny26@gmail.com.

13. Complaint to a supervisory authority

The user has the right to lodge a complaint with the competent data-protection supervisory authority, in particular if they believe that processing infringes the GDPR.

14. Automated decision-making

The current beta version is not intended to rely on solely automated decision-making about a user that produces legal or similarly significant effects. If such a feature is introduced, it must be separately legally assessed and described before deployment.

15. Cookies, localStorage and sessionStorage

GO IRL may use technically necessary cookies or web storage for authentication, security, session state and the user-requested application flow. Non-essential analytics, advertising or tracking storage requires separate assessment and consent where required by law.

16. Security

GO IRL uses reasonable technical and organizational measures appropriate to the current architecture of the service. No internet system can be described as absolutely secure.

17. Personal-data security incidents

If a personal-data breach occurs, GO IRL will assess it and fulfil notification or information obligations under GDPR Articles 33 and 34 where the legal conditions are met.

18. Changes to this Policy

This Policy may be updated when the service, data flows or legal requirements change. The current version and effective date will be published on this page. If a change requires new consent, that consent will be requested separately.
